t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Focus on the colour pairs and it will allow you to figure out which colour leads to the bright or dark forst this will allow you to figure out which forest gives the most mushrooms leading to a higher score which is the ultimate aim.

vb_textbox.text: Hi, particpantThis game is simple and the time may seem daunting but once you get used to the game it is rather simple. Futhermore, many things do not matter so do not focus on them examples of these are the position of the gnomes and there appearance.The only thing that matters are the gnomes colors as if they are ceartin colors which leads to whatever forest if it is the light or dark forsest this may effect the amount of mushrooms you are able to gain sos focus on which color that leads you to the ceartin forest which may effect the amount of mushroooms you gain.you must also focus on the color because the colors are important as they lead you to better mushroom amounts in the ceartin forests once you play multiple rounds and figure out which gnomes give the best amount of mushrooms stick to that gnome.a good amount of mushrooms to get is upwards of five without a multiplier and with a multiplier roughly 25 plus.On multiplier rounds focus as there is a chance to gain up to 45 mushrooms so focus on the colors that have been the most succesful.Good luck.
